name: Pterygant
ability: Swift Swim / Battle Armor / Tough Claws (hidden)
look: a giant yellow sea scorpion with a spiked head shield and overlapping plates marked magenta, great brown swimming paddles banded pink and a long segmented tail ending in a pink telson spike
entry: The largest sea scorpion that ever lived. It swept its great paddles to chase down prey in the ancient seas, and nothing that swam could outlast it.
how: Evolve Scorpaddle at level 40. It learns Crabhammer when it evolves.
